topic: Why one page per service beats one page listing everything
caption:
Stuffing every service onto one page splits your ranking power.
Google wants to match one page to one search.
Split your services out. Each one gets its own page, its own keywords, its own shot at the top.
We build sites structured to rank from day one. Link in bio.

copy.headline: One Service Per Page Wins More Searches
copy.body: Google ranks pages, not lists. A dedicated page for AC repair beats a catch-all Services page every time a Victorville homeowner types that exact search.
